input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only liability limitation in the Agreement (p0077, buried in the indemnity section) is one-sided: it caps TrueLink's liability at 12 months' hosting/support compensation, while Client's liability — including under the very broad indemnity in Section 12(a) (p0071-p0072) covering any breach, Web Site/Client Content claims and third-party injury — is entirely uncapped. That is squarely in walk-away territory ("Customer's liability uncapped while Vendor's is capped") and fails the fallback, which requires a mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct. There is also no defined set of carve-outs (only TrueLink's own gross negligence/wilful misconduct is excepted) and no confirmation that Client's payment obligations sit outside the cap. Our redline makes the cap mutual and agreement-wide at the greater of 12 months' fees and US$1,000,000 and adds a single Excluded Claims sentence. We have not added a mutual consequential-damages waiver (absent from the document), as its absence preserves our recovery against the vendor; that is noted rather than redlined.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTH PERIOD AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US$1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; AND CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the liability cap mutual and agreement-wide: as drafted only TrueLink's liability is limited (and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11), while Client's exposure under the broad Section 12(a) indemnity is unlimited. Our position is a mutual cap of the greater of 12 months' fees and US$1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap; a straight mutual 12-month fee cap with those carve-outs is an acceptable fallback.
proposal.summary: Make the cap mutual and agreement-wide at the greater of 12 months' fees or US$1,000,000, with standard uncapped carve-outs.
